decisions.reasoning: META enters earnings with a massive pre-run (+14% from the $484.66 low on April 21 to $554.50), elevated IV at 106% (pricing ~7.7% expected move), and mixed historical post-earnings reactions despite consistent EPS beats (Q4 +2.2%, Q3 -4.4%, Q2 +5.4%, Q1 -10.7%). The existing bear put spread (long $547.50 / short $510) is now slightly OTM and underwater. Given the directional uncertainty and rich premium environment, rotating from a directional bearish bet into a delta-neutral long strangle better captures the implied volatility while avoiding further losses on the mispositioned spread.
